title: Handmade Ceramic Coffee Mug - Ocean Blue
description:
Beautiful handcrafted ceramic coffee mug with a stunning ocean blue glaze. Each piece is wheel-thrown and fired to perfection.

Features:
- Unique ocean blue glaze
- Comfortable handle design
- Food-safe and lead-free
- Microwave and dishwasher safe

Dimensions:
- Height: 4 inches
- Diameter: 3.5 inches
- Capacity: 12 oz

Each mug is handmade, so slight variations in color and size make each piece unique.

title: Vintage Style Leather Bookmark - Brown
description:
Elegant handcrafted leather bookmark made from premium full-grain leather. Perfect for book lovers and makes a wonderful gift.

Features:
- Genuine full-grain leather
- Hand-cut and hand-finished
- Natural brown color that ages beautifully
- Slim design won't damage book spines

Dimensions:
- Length: 8 inches
- Width: 1.5 inches

The leather will develop a unique patina over time, making each bookmark truly one-of-a-kind.

title: Hand-Poured Soy Candle - Lavender & Vanilla
description:
Relax with this luxurious hand-poured soy candle featuring a calming blend of lavender and vanilla essential oils. Made with 100% natural soy wax for a clean, long-lasting burn.

Scent Profile:
- Top notes: Fresh lavender
- Heart notes: Sweet vanilla
- Base notes: Light musk

Details:
- 8 oz glass jar
- 100% soy wax
- Cotton wick
- Burn time: approximately 40-45 hours
- Phthalate-free fragrance

Perfect for creating a peaceful atmosphere in any room.

title: Macramé Wall Hanging - Boho Style
description:
Beautiful handmade macramé wall hanging that adds a touch of bohemian charm to any space. Perfect for bedrooms, living rooms, or nurseries.

Features:
- 100% natural cotton rope
- Handcrafted with intricate knotting
- Wooden dowel hanger included
- Boho/minimalist design

Dimensions:
- Width: 16 inches
- Length: 24 inches (including fringe)
- Dowel: 18 inches

Easy to hang with included hanging loop. Each piece is handmade and may have slight variations.
